//: Herdr board rules shipped with the package. Don't edit this file: put your own in ~/.config/veroboard/config.json (same shape). Its lists are ADDED to these; blocked.disable turns built-in rules off by id (ids: see rules.js).

people.//names: Only these people count as someone an agent waits on ('Blocked · Luke'). Empty: any capitalized name does. Agents (t22) always count.
people.//notPeople: Tools and models: 'waiting on Codex' is background work (the board shows it as Waiting), not a person.

blocked.//asks: Phrases (whole words, any case) near the end of an agent's last message that mean it waits for YOU: Blocked · You.
blocked.//notAsks: Phrases that mark a sentence as not an ask: that sentence is ignored.
blocked.//nothingForYou: Phrases near the end that say you have nothing to do: never Blocked · You.
blocked.//todoLabels: Line-start labels that hand you a to-do ('Still yours: add the vault key'). 'still'/'also' in front work too.
blocked.//patterns: Advanced: regular expressions (JavaScript, case-insensitive) for asks and not-asks.
blocked.//disable: Built-in rule ids to switch off, e.g. ["paste", "question"].

board.//: How the board looks and behaves (Veroboard settings → Display). Theme colors come from your Herdr theme. Your config's "board" section overrides any of these.
board.//cablesThroughCards: How much the patch cables show through the cards, in % (0 to 50).
board.//cableColors: The patch cables' colors: "rainbow" (the theme's colors) or "grey" (shades of grey).
board.//contextRamp: The context bar is plain below the first number, then turns from peach to red, fully red at the second (%).
board.//stuckTask: Background work with no news for this long (minutes) shows its time in pink: a sub-agent and a shell the agent waits on since they started, a monitor since its last event.
board.//waitTask: What keeps a card in Waiting while it runs: sub-agents, shells the agent waits on, monitors, hc helper terminals. Off: the card goes to Done when its turn ends.
board.//toastPlace: Where notifications pop up on the board (Veroboard settings → Notifications): top, middle or bottom, then left, center or right, as "top-right".
board.//toastArea: Over the "board" (the top half) or over the "terminal" (the bottom half); toastPlace is the spot in that area.
board.//noticeRead: When a notification counts as read: "open" (opening the bell's list), "visit" (clicking it, or going to its agent's terminal) or "hand" (clicking it, or its ✓ in the list).
board.//card: What each card shows and where (Veroboard settings → Card): three lines, each with a left and right side; hidden badges; rows: the background work rows under a card.
board.//top: The top bar (Veroboard settings → Board): one line with a left and right side, and hidden items. The gear can't be hidden.
